description: This file defines the ShareAccountWritePlatformService interface, which declares methods for creating, updating, approving, activating, rejecting, undoing approval, closing, applying for additional shares, approving/rejecting additional shares, and redeeming shares within the share account management module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: ShareAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface declaring methods for performing write operations related to share accounts, such as creating, updating, approving, closing, and redeeming shares.

methods.name: createShareAccount
methods.description: Creates a new share account based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateShareAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing share account identified by accountId using data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: approveShareAccount
methods.description: Approves a share account identified by accountId using data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: activateShareAccount
methods.description: Activates a share account identified by accountId with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: rejectShareAccount
methods.description: Rejects a share account identified by entityId with details from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: undoApproveShareAccount
methods.description: Reverses the approval of a share account identified by entityId.

methods.name: closeShareAccount
methods.description: Closes a share account identified by accountId.

methods.name: applyAddtionalShares
methods.description: Applies for additional shares on a share account.

methods.name: approveAdditionalShares
methods.description: Approves an application for additional shares.

methods.name: rejectAdditionalShares
methods.description: Rejects an application for additional shares.

methods.name: redeemShares
methods.description: Redeems shares from a share account.
